title: Plunder in the Smokehouse
body:
## Flow

Only here as a callout check: `[!loot]` does not occur in the reference scenes
(they must not be touched — CLAUDE.md), but the renderer has to show the box
just like the other five.

> [!loot] Two bales of smuggled tobacco, a silver ring on the keeper's thumb
> and a bill of lading without a sender.

> [!invented] Unknown callout kind — degrades to a normal quote,
> never an error.
